tests.title: every selector result and panel carries one provenance tag, and the baseline is labelled "Sample data, illustrative"
a group of fewer than 5 is never shown, in any role, dataset, section, period or site
the group-size rule can be raised in Settings but never lowered below 5
one dataset per view: a cohort view holds no case-backed figure, a case view holds no cohort figure, exports never mix
administrator and supervisor get aggregates only: no clinical text in their state, no drill-down, no patient initials in the digest
direct support gets no analytics; a supervisor counts only their own sites
the clinician digest equals what the clinician would compute from their own state
a payer decision moves the unresolved count, the awarded units and the offers waiting (S5 → S6)
a request that is sent moves "sends with receipts" (S3 → S6)
a processed note moves notes on time, and a draft with a failed check moves items caught early (S1 → S6)
the CSV prints exactly what the panels print, with period, filters, dataset and definitions
the PDF is a valid multi-page document carrying the same cells, the dataset, the period and the definitions
the question box answers from the data on screen, says so when it cannot, and labels itself Simulated
no story date is written into the analytics code (the demo clock is the only source)
admin: three sections render, aggregates only, no drill-down, no console errors, within the density target
clinician: drill-down opens the patients behind a group; the cohort offers none
supervisor: own sites only, scorecard and sections render
a filter changes the figures and the URL; a tab is a real link; reload keeps the view
the artifact layout: headline cards, lines with metric chips, tiles, feedback blocks, bars; every chart keeps its table; nothing computed on screen
a table over 10 rows pages at the bottom with 10, 25, 50 and 100 rows per page; the choice is in the URL and survives a reload
the CSV file the Export button writes matches the panels on screen, cell for cell
the PDF export downloads and the question box answers on screen
the old payer playbook link (?panel=guidance) opens the payer guidance drawer from Payer Performance
earlier views stay reachable and the scorecard opens its detail
/api/state answers 500 on load: an alert says the server cannot be reached, with Retry; never "Nothing needs you right now" or an endless "Loading"
the server does not answer at all (the request is dropped): the same error state
the session ended (401): "Your session ended" with Sign in again, not an empty screen; Sign in again opens the sign-in screen
a failure after the screen loaded keeps the last good data and says so; when the server returns the screen is current again
a signed-out visitor is not shown an error: the sign-in screen loads from the public roster
matrix: every documented capability, every role
admin has no clinical-record access; notes.view is never granted by a designation
can(): A needs the caseload, D needs the designation, unknown role/capability/user fail closed
routes: every registry route has a capability entry; each role opens exactly what the matrix allows
every action has a capability entry (and nothing is declared for an action that does not exist)
anonymous: /api/state, /api/do (admin and plain actions), /files and the roster
no screening transcript reaches an unauthenticated caller: /api/state is 401, the roster is empty, the scripted call needs a session
a made-up or tampered token is the same as no token
action sweep: every action x every staff role gets 401/403 exactly when the matrix says no
presenter controls need presenter mode, not only a role
user.update: a role change is presenter-only; designations go through two people
projection: direct support sees only their caseload; no screenings, drafts, versions, fills, other staff notes
projection: admin sees unit balances and authorization status but no clinical text
projection: supervisor sees status and their reviewees' notes; clinician sees clinical text
a role switch changes what the API returns (same server, different token)
service line: outpatient (P.G., R-0377) never appears in the staff state
portal sessions: a guardian sees one child; a school user sees their own school; neither can use staff actions
files need a session and the right role
cross-origin: JSON only and an origin allow-list on state-changing calls
presenter PIN and DEMO_PRESENTER are honoured by sign-in
a plain sign-in is never a presenter; the public roster says whether presenter mode exists and needs a PIN, and never carries the PIN
createSession: PIN required when PRESENTER_PIN is set (wrong or missing is 403 with pin flag), the right PIN elevates, DEMO_PRESENTER=0 never does
regression (URA-05/06/10): writing localStorage.psyflo_user, or reloading, never turns a role session into another person or a presenter
with PRESENTER_PIN set: the server and the dock ask for the PIN, a wrong PIN is refused, the right PIN unlocks the presenter tools (own server)
